toegepas.rede_vinder: 'voor jy praat as die woede opkom' can be read as 'before you speak when the anger rises'; fronting the condition makes clear it governs both commands.
toegepas.fout: 'Wag voor jy praat as die woede opkom' lets the condition attach to 'praat' only, which makes a reader stumble.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Putting the condition first makes clear it governs both commands, with the same actions in the same order and no extra length.

toegepas.fout: The fixed expression is reflexive 'jou in iemand se plek indink'; 'in iemand anders se plek dink' breaks it.

laat_vaar.voor: Hartseer wys nie by almal op dieselfde manier nie.
laat_vaar.na: Hartseer lyk nie by almal dieselfde nie.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Intransitive 'wys' here follows English 'shows'; 'lyk nie by almal dieselfde nie' is more natural and shorter.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'lyk' narrows the sense to appearance, while the paragraph describes behaviour (crying, going quiet, getting angry), and the original reads naturally.

laat_vaar.blok: Wat jy met 'n groot gevoel kan doen
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The disappointment is their own; the possessive reads more naturally than the definite article.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Afrikaans naturally uses the definite article where English uses a possessive, so 'die teleurstelling' already reads well and the swap is lateral.

laat_vaar.voor: Hy kan wel bly waar sy maat is.
laat_vaar.na: Hy kan wel by sy maat bly.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'bly waar sy maat is' is wooden; 'by sy maat bly' is the natural phrase, keeps the meaning and matches 'Bly by jou maat' later in the lesson.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'by sy maat bly' can also mean staying over at or living with the friend, while 'bly waar sy maat is' says only that he stays present, so the preposition change moves the meaning.

laat_vaar.voor: Dit kan die grootmens by die huis wees
laat_vaar.na: Dit kan 'n grootmens by die huis wees
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The three options are parallel ('n onderwyser, 'n verpleegster), so the indefinite article fits; 'die grootmens' suggests one specific person.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'die grootmens by die huis' naturally means the child's own caregiver and reads well; changing it alters who to tell in a safety instruction for the sake of parallelism only.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The intended meaning is that the feeling makes you want to push back ('laat wil'); 'wil laat' says the feeling wants to make you.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'dit wil jou laat terugstoot' is idiomatic Afrikaans ('wil' meaning 'tends to'), so this is no grammar error, and the definition is shared wording.

laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Intransitive 'iets maak seer' is standard Afrikaans, so this glossary definition has no grammar fault to fix.
